tldr: Midday batch, Aug 19: Cerebras unveils CS-4, a rack-scale wafer engine with three WSE-3 Turbo wafers (750 PFLOPS, up to 30x more tokens/sec per user than GPUs) shipping this quarter, as inference economics become the battleground. ByteDance + Tsinghua's CUDA Agent beats torch.compile on KernelBench, Claude gains agent scaffolding (MCP, web search, structured outputs) on Azure-hosted Foundry, and GLM-5.3's Artificial Analysis benchmarks top HN. Qwen keeps momentum: Qwen3.8-27B ranks #1 open-weight on Harvey's Legal Agent benchmark and a new midsize 3.8 model is teased for next week. Anthropic prioritizes a scientist access program with Opus 5 as its life-science flagship. Hermes Agent: desktop app on all three platforms, 2,500+ contributors, and confirmed zero telemetry. Plus a BFI paper on US wage declines and a helium-filled soft robot from Keio/MIT.

articles.title: Cerebras CS-4: Rack-Scale Wafer Engine, 30x Faster Than GPUs
articles.summary: Three WSE-3 Turbo wafers (4T transistors each) in one rack deliver 750 PFLOPS and up to 30x more tokens/sec per user vs GPUs; first shipments this quarter.

articles.title: ByteDance's CUDA Agent Writes GPU Kernels Faster Than torch.compile
articles.summary: RL-trained in a CUDA sandbox: 98.8% pass, 96.8% faster than torch.compile on KernelBench (2.11x geomean), ~40 pts ahead of Opus 4.5 and Gemini 3 Pro.

articles.title: Claude Gains Agent Scaffolding on Azure-Hosted Foundry
articles.summary: Structured outputs, web search/fetch, MCP connector, and tool search now run on Azure-hosted Claude — regulated teams keep prompts in-region and ship agents.

articles.title: GLM-5.3 Artificial Analysis Benchmarks
articles.summary: Artificial Analysis publishes a benchmark page for Zhipu's flagship GLM-5.3 — top HN post (100 pts) as its scores circulate.

articles.title: New Midsize Qwen 3.8 Model Coming Next Week
articles.summary: Qwen community manager confirms a new midsize open-weight model (likely >100B) lands next week; no early access due to schedule.

articles.title: Anthropic to Launch Scientist Access Program; Opus 5 Leads Life Science
articles.summary: Anthropic prioritizes an access program giving scientists use of its most capable models; Opus 5 remains its strongest model for life-science research.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-27B Is #1 Open-Weight Model on Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark
articles.summary: The 27B local model tops Harvey's Legal Agent benchmark as the #1 open-weight model — strong enough for professional legal-agent workflows.

articles.title: Hermes Agent Desktop Now on macOS, Windows, and Linux
articles.summary: Nous Research ships the Hermes Agent desktop app on all three major platforms at hermes-agent.nousresearch.com.

articles.title: Hermes Agent Crosses 2,500 Contributors
articles.summary: Teknium highlights Hermes Agent as a 100% free, MIT-licensed agent harness built by Nous Research and 2,500+ contributors.

articles.title: Hermes Agent Ships With Zero Telemetry
articles.summary: Teknium confirms no telemetry in Hermes Agent today — only required provider identification; opt-in telemetry may come later.

articles.title: New BFI Paper: 37% of US Workers Saw Real Wages Decline 2021-2024
articles.summary: BFI working paper finds 37% of US workers saw real wage declines from 2021-2024 — top of HN (261 pts, 125 comments).

articles.title: Floating Soft Robot Designed to Be Touched Like a Pet
articles.summary: Keio + MIT Media Lab built a helium-filled, faceless floating robot with flapping fins — alarm clock, study buddy, dance partner demos.
